top5.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals pro-tumorigenic intestinal mast cell programs in colorectal cancer
top5.why: Intestinal mast cells undergo tumor microenvironment-driven metabolic and transcriptional reprogramming toward an immunosuppressive, pro-tumorigenic phenotype conserved between mouse and human colorectal cancer.

top5.title: Canine hookworm infections in Vietnam: prevalence, risk factors, and detection of zoonotic Ancylostoma ceylanicum
top5.why: Zoonotic Ancylostoma ceylanicum circulates in Vietnamese dogs at high prevalence, associated with lack of deworming and poor fecal management, sharing identical haplotypes with human infections across Asia.

top5.title: Impact of rumen microbiome sample handling and extraction procedures on downstream long-read sequencing
top5.authors: Amorin de Hegedus R … McClure JC
top5.why: Precipitation-based DNA extraction and flash freezing preserve high-molecular-weight DNA integrity better than bead-based methods and freeze-thaw cycles for accurate rumen microbiome profiling via long-read sequencing.

top5.title: Nanoparticle-based photodynamic therapy and immune checkpoint modulation: a new frontier in cancer immunotherapy
top5.why: Multifunctional nanocarriers co-delivering photosensitizers with oxygen-generating components and immunomodulatory agents can overcome hypoxia and delivery barriers to enhance PDT-checkpoint blockade combinations in preclinical tumor models.

top5.title: Stepping (hi)stones: Charting a single-cell multiomic path toward understanding the human brain
top5.why: Single-cell multiomics reveals cell-type-specific transcriptional-epigenetic landscapes across human brain regions and links neurological variants to regulatory mechanisms.

also.title: Sexually transmitted co-infections as biological modifiers of HPV-driven cervical carcinogenesis: a systematic integrative review
also.why: HIV co-infection shows probable causal modification of HPV-driven cervical carcinogenesis with six-fold risk elevation and CD4 dose-response, while Chlamydia trachomatis causality remains uncertain and HSV-2 lacks sufficient evidence for independent co-factor status.

also.title: Genotype-phenotype single-cell transcriptomics for massive parallel assessment of genetic variants
also.why: SCRAMseq enables high-throughput single-cell mapping of thousands of genetic variants to their functional effects, expanding massively parallel variant assessment beyond predefined assays to any disease-relevant pathway.

also.title: Cell sorting as a strategy for chimerism and relapse assessment in hematologic neoplasms: a case report
also.why: Case report in a leading general journal. Topics: cell sorting.

also.title: Absolute quantification and profiling of cellular tRNAs by nanopore sequencing and a deep learning classifier
also.why: Nanopore sequencing with deep learning enables accurate absolute quantification of cellular tRNAs and single-molecule detection of modifications without cDNA synthesis bias.

also.title: Biomimetic nanoparticles for cancer vaccines and immunotherapy: mechanisms, tumor microenvironment reprogramming, and translational perspectives
also.why: Biomimetic nanoparticles derived from cells or extracellular vesicles can modulate dendritic cell activation, T-cell priming, and tumor microenvironment through customizable surface composition and cargo, though clinical translation requires standardized manufacturing and rigorous preclinical validation.

also.title: Development of a Genetically Characterized Panel of 15 Mucosal Melanoma Cell Lines for the Preclinical Evaluation of Targeted Therapies in Human and Veterinary Medicine
also.why: Canine mucosal melanoma cell lines recapitulate human disease genetics and enable identification of TP53-dependent MDM2 inhibitor sensitivity for preclinical therapeutic testing.
